handback.summary: Added a release command and a workflow that tag and release v0.1.0 from the changelog on main.

criteria.755.1: `dokima/release.py` `run()` makes the v0.1.0 tag at the pushed commit; skips with no changelog, no section, or an existing release.
criteria.755.2: `run()` calls `gh release create v0.1.0`; a refusal exits 1 with GitHub's reason. `.github/workflows/release.yml` runs it on push to main.
criteria.755.3: `section()` takes only the lines under the v0.1.0 heading as the notes, up to the next heading.

raises.label: Changelog not yet written
raises.text: No changelog exists on main yet, so this workflow makes no release until one lands.
raises.evidence: No `CHANGELOG.md` at the repo root; #849 holds it.
